EasyUse Anima 0.6.1 adds more stage-scoped AiO patches and makes Prompt Studio queue results transactional.

Changes:
1. Safe PAG and SageAttention can target the first pass, Highres, Detailer, and Upscale stages independently while existing workflows keep their previous all-stage behavior.
2. Connected Prompt Studio inputs update the exact linked fields for the accepted queue without saving execution-only overlays as local fallback text.
3. Successful NAIA queues update the matching positive and negative NAIA fields and the accepted resolution as canonical workflow values.
4. Newer accepted queues keep field ownership; out-of-order, duplicate, missing, and mismatched execution identities fail closed instead of restoring older results.
5. Wildcard, linked-input, and NAIA projections share one queue transaction and settle once across all affected fields.

Action required:
After updating, restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser.
